label: Day shift, competent operator
notes: The baseline the procedure was written for, and the reason the procedure looks fine on paper.

label: Night shift, two months in the job
notes: Qualified on a different tank group. Doing this transfer for the second time unsupervised.

label: Relief operator, eleventh hour of a night rotation
notes: Knows the procedure cold. Coverage from the third night of a four night block.

label: Contracted crew, procedure not in the working language
notes: Competent on the equipment, reading a controlled document that he translates in his head while a truck waits.

label: Late dispatch, three vehicles waiting
notes: The scenario the schedule was designed to produce: behind, busy, and every check is one minute of lost turnaround.

label: First transfer after the turnaround
notes: Experienced crew, unfamiliar plant: half the instruments have been bench tested and the line-up has changed.
